## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle anonymous Lotus-family Esoteric ritual manual, paralleling the better-known Amoghavajra version ([KR6j0039](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0039), T18n0873). The Taishō header notes the cross-references "[cf. Nos. 873, 874]" — confirming this as a parallel recension within the Vajradhātu corpus.

**Abstract**

The *Liánhuábù xīn niànsòng yíguǐ* (T875) is the **anonymous parallel** to Amoghavajra's *Jīngāngdǐng liánhuábù xīn niànsòng yíguǐ* (T873, [KR6j0039](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0039)). The two texts share the same ritual function — the Lotus-family *xīn niànsòng* (heart-recitation) practice for the *iṣṭa-devatā* of the Lotus-family (Amitāyus / Avalokiteśvara) — but the two recensions differ in the specific ritual prescriptions.

The text's anonymous transmission and short length suggest a working ritual handbook rather than a translated scripture; conventionally placed in the **late Tang** period (8th–9th c.).
